notes.pairs: Each round measures every backend once in randomized order, using identical fixed inputs; every round retained
notes.blocks: Short blocks of10 calls by default, with synchronization at both ends; no profiler
notes.precision: FP16 decoder uses FP32 computation plus input/output casts for every backend; tiny_host is FP32
notes.graph: Shared input tensors and one captured graph per backend; repeated paired replay rounds each epoch
notes.process_cpu_time: Diagnostic across all process threads; includes runtime synchronization and is not pure Python overhead
notes.pinning: Two least-busy allowed physical cores selected from a250ms /proc/stat sample; masks applied to all existing threads and inherited by later workers
notes.comparability: Controlled confirmation workload; absolute wall times may differ from unpinned prior run
